This discovery can be obtained from Map of a Frozen Beast in Sakai Archives

Pre-requisite action (hidden): North Eurasia permit obtained

comments.author: Edgedemon
comments.body: is interesting to find this here, if i remember right, the frozen cave lion cubs were found in 2015, and they already made their way to UWO

comments.author: RvZ
comments.body: Requires Lion discovery to pull the map

comments.author: Nour
comments.body: With the Lion discovery only, I have not managed to get this map after using 20 Headache Meds. However, with the Siberian Cat discovery, it dropped almost instantaneously. Either both the Lion discovery and the Siberian Can discovery is required, or only the Siberian Cat discovery, though I am inclined to say both.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
In looking at it, I believe this discovery/map only requires the Siberian Cat in order to be obtained. Quote:

"It came out after the lion was not found and the Siberian was found." (Google Translation)
Source: gvdb.mydns.jp/db/module/QuestDB/action/QuestShow?id=5763

I will mark it as such on the map details. Cheers.
